column1: # Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition 3.0.1 (SDK 21.4.4, Monolith, NVN2).
# The host and these modules supply the imports from the two other subsdks.
# Monolith reserves two 60 GB ranges (reach +120.13 GB): upstream's Mac gives a Switch 2 game a 128 GB alias region (NXNative a694f1799), which NX 18 has not taken;
# NX 18's Mac gives 64 GB, so this game does not start on NX 18 yet (README.md)
# MapPhysicalMemory refused past the 9 GB pool, as on Horizon: upstream's host turns it on for every Switch 2 game (a694f1799); an uncapped probe there mapped all 60 GB and left the next arena null
